title: Craftmanship and welding is not up to par.
text:
Craftmanship and welding is not up to par.. The stools seems sturdy after its put together, it’s also heavy.

I’m disapointed in this counter stool. It’s not up to par for me.
The welding on the chair is un-even, and not a professional job.
The seat is large, but not comfortable, it’s hard, not padded well.
Its not 24 inches high, its 22 to 23 inches, and does not match up to my other 24 inch counter stools.
Does not Swivel easy at all, or needs to be used more! After it was put together the grease underneath for the swivel
Came ozzing out on my husbands hands!
The seat is washable. Fabric looks good, although could be sewed better, and thicker.
Craftsmanship should be better.

That said, when you buy something new ,and after you take the time to put the whole thing together you notice
Everything , and we certainly did on this stool!

The design is nice.
After All is said and done, hope my guest will Not notice the poor workmanship on this stool !!!

product_metadata.title: Hillsdale Hanover Swivel Counter Height Stool, Brown
features: Classic metal counter height stool with an elegant Chippendale geometric back
The decorative metal frame features elegant curves and a warm brown finish
The upholstered round 360 swivel seat features a beautiful textured beige faux suede fabric
Overall Dimensions: 38.5H x 21.5W x 21.5D; Seat Height: 26H
Constructed from tubular steel, fossil stone and polyester
Works best with counters that are 34-38 inches in height
The touch of a clean, damp cloth is the only care your furniture will ever need
description: A combination of organic shapes and geometric patterns make the Hillsdale Furniture Hanover Swivel Bar Height Stool a style stand-out. This brown metal stool features understated cabriole legs and an arched back with a central geometric Chippendale design. Its 360° swivel seat is amply padded and upholstered in Beige faux suede upholstery that has a soft hand and textured pattern. Supports up to 250 lbs. Assembly required.
